cover_headline: DHS Proposes Ending Deference to Prior H-1B and L-1 Petition Approvals

end.headline: DHS Proposes Ending Deference to Prior H-1B and L-1 Petition Approvals
end.line: A proposed rule would remove the requirement that USCIS defer to earlier I-129 approvals, exposing extensions and amendments to fresh adjudication.

facts: The proposal would remove the requirement that USCIS defer to earlier I-129 approvals
DHS is inviting public comments for 30 days after the Federal Register publication on October 14
Indian nationals make up a significant share of H-1B beneficiaries, working in technology, engineering, healthcare and other specialized occupations
